reply_text:
I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. The official date Pellucid Harbor Logistics changed hands to him is **November 3, 2025**.

The date comes from Moss's Coastal digest of 2025-11-02, which says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's Dec 8 cutover recap, a public note, gives the same date.

The recap also says Bettina ran the account day to day until Nov 21 and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told him to use Nov 3 for the CRM's official ownership date. He should use Nov 22 only if the field records when he actually took over day to day.
